theme: An open day, poised before tomorrow's move.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan — nothing between you and the work you choose. Tomorrow brings the house changeover and a 3:30 intro call, so today is the day to get ahead of both.

needsAttention.title: Lauren Nadig is ready to lock tomorrow's call
needsAttention.detail: She replied this morning asking whether to send the Teams invite for the 3:30 intro call tomorrow. A quick yes closes it before the day fills — the connection came through Josh Pasichow at Brunswick.

needsAttention.title: Build and pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow is the House 1 to House 2 changeover. Packing the bin today makes the first migration a test run while there's still time to fix what doesn't work.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 19 Cavtat night and transfer
needsAttention.detail: Charter connectivity is poor to none, so the post-sail Cavtat hotel and the Komolac airport transfer have to be booked before you fly Sept 8. It's a P1 that's been open since late August.

flagged.title: PRI intro call still to be scheduled
flagged.detail: Conor Kehoe's office sent a Zoom invite for the PRI sustainability and stewardship conversation Eugenia Jackson set up — it isn't on your calendar yet.

flagged.title: Bio still owed to Ellen and Deb
flagged.detail: Your own reminder to send your email address and bio to Ellen and Deb is sitting unactioned.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley flagged a payment
flagged.detail: An automated payment posted that they're asking you to review and confirm you recognize.

flagged.title: Care.com applicants waiting
flagged.detail: Three sitters have applied to your job post, and one is flagged as waiting to hear back.

inbox.noise: The rest is Labor Day retail, travel-loyalty mail, and language-app newsletters.
inbox.clear: Your Nautilus sailing balance is paid and confirmed — nothing owed there.

recipe.title: Fricassée of chanterelles
recipe.why: Early autumn is peak chanterelle season, when the woods give up their best wild mushrooms.

tasks.title: Book St. Pete lodging for the Sept 20–22 landing gap
Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket, in writing
Book a refundable Sept 20–Oct 5 rental as the car backup
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the morning is entirely unclaimed.
An open runway, the last clear stretch before tomorrow's house changeover.
Your final night at the Kenwood house before the move to the St. Pete ranch.
